notes.title: V0.979 | 3000AD | New Side Quest | Arena | Custom Robo
notes.notes: [h2]Well met, time travelers![/h2][h3][/h3][h3]These past two months I've been chiseling away at the second to last alpha update.[/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/bc66f4fc279f32cc9c622328200e6369d0075f3a.png"][/img][/p][p][b]News Art and some of the gif media was submitted by Odebla![/b][/p][p][/p][h2]Travel into the end of THE THIRD MILLENNIUM![/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/7fe7c63ddecadbd823ea021291140ab032a961e8.png"][/img][/p][p][b]See Pine Island grow into a City Island, with several districts dotted around the island![/b][/p][p][b]Most of them can be visited after 2300AD[/b][/p][p][/p][h3]Star Gazer Palace[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/8ec99c43653d4e491b9ec4fc4d7498fcba6337c7.gif"][/img][/p][p][b]Built on Mount Uroruh, one of its smaller peaks, peeking out through the floor of the palace ^^[/b][/p][p][b]Visit the new palace of leadership in the city! Open to the public.[/b][/p][p][/p][h3]The Market District [/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/af8a5434573acf64ab34abe98117e312ad689736.gif"][/img][/p][p][b]In here you can find all kinds of interesting futuristic items to gain.[/b][/p][p][b]And places to visit.[/b][/p][p][/p][h3]The North District[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/b588e59c1744a10f6634cb1be2b079fdbb331e7f.gif"][/img][/p][p][b]Amongst the local pub, this place contains an antique shop, where you can sell all kinds of items for money![/b][/p][p][/p][h3]The Harbor![/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/71f8eef29ba7ab6f9ecce12f23d1a7f756ebda08.gif"][/img][/p][p][b]This is the domain of the fisher folk, as well as a nice vista for the space port![/b][/p][p][/p][h3]The Arena[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/effbc0575ffde526e50768e5486791fcde55db4d.gif"][/img][/p][p][b]So far in AD 1600 and post 2300, you will be able to earn your money by beating down waves of opponents![/b][/p][p][/p][h3]The Last Athor[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/8ac24afe17776552908125cfa1820e5b2a524b44.gif"][/img][/p][p][b]At the end of 2999 You will be able to visit the last Athor, he lives on top of Star Gazer Palace.[/b][/p][p][b]The empire has crumbled, is there any hope for what is to come?[/b][/p][p][/p][h3]The Starport[/h3][p][b]The hub of going between Earth & Moon and perhaps beyond. [/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/dc781c688341c482e2930e3fea063ebb8a75637b.gif"][/img][/p][p][b]That begs the question, would you like to go with your time machine or rocket beyond earth? Maybe in some update after the game is fully released. Being able to insert the space core instead of the time core into the car, same way it works for the space gate. What are your thoughts? Could this work in a similar way to world addons?[/b][/p][p][/p][h3]Make your own Robo Companion![/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/73646eee6201182d85c714aa0a43ae9de9965f4d.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Pick the Main Robo module and assemble your own robo companion from various parts![/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/f61860413a33489f97c62c2a7a9c5bc2385b85f9.gif"][/img][/p][p][b]They cannot do much yet but definitely a nice addition as a companion on your time travel adventures![/b][/p][p][b]If you have ideas for ROBO features write them in the comments![/b][/p][p][/p][h3]The Music for 3000AD[/h3][p]I added music from my older Star Wars project to give the future a more mystical feeling.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/94e2b2f0fcb7859515aaa87ddfae107414bd0bec.png"][/img][/p][p]The music files were originally composed by Gustav Holst and recorded by United States Air Force Heritage of America Band and is therefore under Public Domain.[/p][p]Gustav Holst also served as inspiration for John Williams scores, so it may give you some similar feels to his compositions.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3]Black Powder[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/11177b763d5eb7137ebb1c03a78bfbc06f7a3e0a.gif"][/img][/p][p][b]If you find a bounty in the sewers you can obtain a new crafting recipe.[/b][/p][p][/p][h3]Bob is missing![/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/16e791cf97dcda2195dd47883de02c71fd64688c.gif"][/img][/p][p][b]There are rumors 1650s that a local named Bob got lost exploring the sewers, perhaps you can find him.[/b][/p][h3][/h3][h3]Alternate Input for Crafting recipes![/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/2e616b2c750b548a743e4bd93700b84a0c67f243.gif"][/img][/p][p][b]Instead of two separate recipes I now did the only smart decision to just unify the recipe with alternate input possibilities.[/b] [/p][p][/p][h3]Environment Aging.[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/59aeb30aaad8d1402c8db5c16600d9f01bf18e14.gif"][/img][/p][p]I've tested some texture applications to reveal aging on older structures. So that very old buildings would not look so pristine and new, but age in surface looks over time.[/p][p][/p][h3]Next updates[/h3][p][/p][p][b]The next updates are planned as followed:[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/c624f3b41a5b2bc704fe90faf654e09ec1ef57eb.png"][/img][/p][p](this list may not include all features planned to be revised and fixed but I do have a full beta bucket list formed for 2026)[/p][p]-Last Story quest and with that end of Alpha.[/p][p]-Beta Update 1 (Performance (potentially migrating to a newer unity version), Item managment, and QoL, potentially a revamp of the tutorial level if not later, extensive bug solving)[/p][p]2026[/p][p]-Beta Update 2 (Finishing Multiplayer & Bug Fixing, potential Story rewrites)[/p][p]-Beta Update 3 (More Bug Fixes, last touches and if all is done maybe adding planting trees[/p][p]Gold Status status is reached, No Time leaves Early Access and goes into the post EA content phase.[/p][p]With more updates to come on a regular basis but once every two to three months.[/p][h3][/h3][h3]Thank you for supporting my work this whole time.[/h3][h3]God bless and enjoy the update![/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/79604bc02768cb664378c15e60350dd5e467fb82.png"][/img][/p][p][b]September 7th V0.979[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added the heir side quest to 3000AD[/p][/*][*][p]Added alternate notes.title: Patch Notes for V0.978

notes.title: V0.978 | Multiplayer Fencing | World Editor Updates | Bug Fixes
notes.notes: [h2]Hello fellow players![/h2][h3][/h3][h3]Today I announce a regular monthly update with fixes and new cool additions to the game![/h3][h3][/h3][h2]Multiplayer Fencing[/h2][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/92f2a0f4435e0e8f782850de886fe422d3540fcb.gif"][/img][/p][p][b]Now you can test your sword capabilities against your friends![/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/123f8794928b4ffd38b54d0d9efba18fa656a88e.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]A health bar should be now displayed above their heads.[/b][/p][p][b]This comes along with several time story/ multiplayer bug fixes.[/b][/p][p][/p][h2]Crashing against Multiplayer Cars.[/h2][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/61628dbf50bbd4361e7723bdeaaa28913416a0da.gif"][/img][/p][p][b]This should now work nicely with an added knock-back effect to prevent the player from being driven over by a static time tracked version of your friend![/b][/p][p][/p][h2][b]World Editor Updates.[/b][/h2][p][b]Along with some travel bug fixes like the issue with the water level a few[/b][/p][p][b]new additions have been made![/b][/p][p][b]You can now add traffic to your world mod! First place a traffic system.[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/a82624c0b7d84427be252e71c9127b4675ddbb0a.gif"][/img][/p][p][b]Spawn in nodes and parent them to the traffic system to create a loop.[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/9631f94ef7f83041eb9d1ac0a3a92b83ab314259.gif"][/img][/p][p][b]Voila, you have working traffic![/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/cfdd6ad6d09dce9c45580a17e1ae2f07f078f7d2.gif"][/img][/p][p][b]Traffic lights are available in a cross roads or t shape crossing formation.[/b][/p][p][/p][h2]Safe-house additions & other goodies[/h2][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/2bade72007b88c4767a5d6784c3e3fc81c840b46.gif"][/img][/p][p][b]Your plc now makes use of of the Manhofer Satellite to locate ore veins![/b][/p][p][b]This should be useful when stranded and in need for uranium for instance.[/b][/p][p][/p][p][b]You are now able to place trash bins (for item disposal), chests and make use of a gold stash.[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/4efc38da3ec81bf4c219b75f0cae4140dd4fa1b9.gif"][/img][/p][p][b]This way you will be able to pay from the stash directly instead of having to place gold bars at the traders desk manually.[/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/b4128bbf7b87d6d6692d5fc4cce6b83cbb0407c3.gif"][/img][/p][p][b]Gasoline explodes upon shooting![/b][/p][p][/p][p][b]The aquarium is now fixed and has all kinds of marine life in it![/b][/p][p][/p][h2]Next updates.[/h2][p][/p][p][b]3000AD[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/4c95b39e81ac2d3a397710f4541b7635c701a1d0.png"][/img][/p][p]The next updates will likely revolve about potentially venturing into 3000AD as a new time zone.[/p][p]This would stretch out the 2050 future into 2250 or later, with the trash level happening afterwards.[/p][p]Meaning you may see some more nice vistas before the ground level becomes a dingy place.[/p][p]What happens after 2300 will be a surprise though.[/p][p][/p][p][b]The End of the Story[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/9bbf15daff91ccef91ca9aa2732e550045c05d4a.png"][/img][/p][p]I think I have the ending pretty much figured out so I am ready to head into finishing the story, for good.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Revamps/ Beta & New Tutorial Level[/b][/p][p]This would include of course more bug fixes and Quality of Life improvements as I move the game towards Beta. [/p][p][/p][p]Another world editor update will allow you to create custom start scenarios, and as one of those scenarios I will create maybe a separate tutorial island[/p][p][/p][p][b]Updates after Beta[/b][/p][p]After the game leaves Early Access, it will continue to get regular updates, even in the content region.[/p][p]This will happen together with the reveal of my future space project.[/p][p]You can check some videos of this project here:[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="s545zaPjXUM;full"][/previewyoutube][h3][b]The plan is to enhance the core structure with a ground fps shooter element, and potential multiplayer modes. An update Demo is planned.[/b][/h3][p][/p][h2][b]I hope you like these new additions and bug fixes, below is the full change log for you to inspect.[/b][/h2][h2][b]Enjoy and good luck on your time travel adventures! And God bless.[/b][/h2][h2][b]-Erathor[/b][/h2][p][/p][p][b]July 8th V0.978[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added melee combat to multiplayer[/p][/*][*][p]Added health bars for players in Multiplayer[/p][/*][*][p]Added an ore scanning feature to the plc map viewer[/p][/*][*][p]Added a gold stash to the safe house, allowing you to draw from it directly if paying for something at the trader[/p][/*][*][p]Added a trash bin to the safe house for easy disposal of items and some minor revamps to the safehouse trader ui[/p][/*][*][p]Added placable safehouse chests[/p][/*][*][p]Added gasoline explodes[/p][/*][*][p]Added the ability to use vertical jets even with hovermode off[/p][/*][*][p]Added small coin types to imperial currency[/p][/*][*][p]Added the ability to charge a lightning rod with a lightning gun[/p][/*][*][p]Added traffic lights to the world editor[/p][/*][*][p]Added traffic systems (car route spawners) to the world editor[/p][/*][*][p]Added the ability to lower the size of the trigger box when you hit a mod world border[/p][/*][*][p]Changed the maximum character amount of a box name to 16[/p][/*][*][p]Revamped and fixed the aquarium of 2050[/p][/*][*][p]Increased car break strength[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the meta key to be a quest essential item, meaning if lost it cannot be wiped by time story[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed items unloading spawned items when putting them into boxes, without first having picked them up[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the wheels from hanging too low[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed in landing mode pause and then unpause, wheels stop working[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed time speeder on lower framerates from making the car jumpy[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the ability for multiplayer cars to phase through your car[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed using the minigun for a time and afterwards the PLC will leave the plc offset too far back[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed campfire item not recognizing natural ground[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the inability to activate or disable headlights or other car systems using the trigger buttons whilst outside the car[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the german translation of the DG research notes[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the german translation for ACT4 during the picking of companions[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the inability to get the no time end achievements after finishing act4[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the blue safehouse trader level preview[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the regular wobble of the car every few seconds[/p][/*][*][p]Fixes to missing past self cars when loading from a save[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the meta keys appearance[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some spelling mistakes[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed driving while drunk being possible[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the lag in the sandbox menu[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the speedometer from going to 0 instantly when notes.title: V0.975 | Car Dealer | Motors&Gas | Visual Car Damage | Roadmap
notes.notes:
[h2]Hello fellow players!
[/h2]
[h3]This one took a bit longer.
The next thing in the roadmap towards Beta has been checked.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/eb89543f2fb0b8afad31f9ecab9119a68acb88e0.png[/img]
Steam Thumbnail Car Screenshots by Niels W.
[h3]That is increased customization of your time machine. That being either using different motor types or even entirely different cars. [/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/c028f88549e0428fcf44cb8e5bb2c6083043af89.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/871b827b214b6d12f0f2a11b36632e3254f574da.gif[/img]
[b]Head to your car dealer and switch out the model for one with different specs.[u] This is now also the way car mods are obtained in game. Not as reskins, but as in game car mods, with their own in game prefixes and specs that can be changed.[/u]

For now you are only able to own one car at a time. However in a future update I may add separate garage to the safe house, for multiple custom car setups.
This also now sets a new way of using car mods. Any mod you own, now has to be acquired this way.[/b]
[b]
You can also set your car to spawn as free option during the prologue stage.[/b]
[b]Max acceleration, weight, health all play a role in your choice![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/0474ce77a711747d5710c0e77dc9e615de0358ac.gif[/img]
[h3]Enhance your old Mach3 with a nice fusion motor for maximum POWER![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/48256390c346ee7f768c15a52b459bad24bd3d52.gif[/img]
[h3]All cars now have their own luggage compartment, as well as an emergency crafter for the most necessary items.[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/018cd13c8fa9c717f412044ce695a94b89a2c7f9.gif[/img]
[h3]For the Semi Truck, you may even sleep in a bunk bed! (You can enable these features also in your car mods)[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/2a1c0993b122146997d9ed3f9a84963d9453c735.gif[/img]
[h3]Watch out, the more damaged your car gets dealt, the easier it is for the motor to get damaged. 
Which will not make your car go into flames (Yet). But you won't be able to move until you get a new motor item![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/d7a68d28c51191cfe0c028dbb14bc0f20fd1abcc.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/9628b3436864664c0d1137473060eb4efc1ff23b.gif[/img]
[h3]Use the gas station to refuel on gas!
(The usage rate of gas is fairly low, so you won't have the necessity to refuel every couple minutes)[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/ec3d5484cd4efeb416aca3e843905568695a8096.gif[/img]
[b]Car damage gets procedurally applied to the car via simple mesh deformations.  Your car mods can also have the deformation feature applied in the editor, by selecting the specific mesh you want to be visual.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/9b2dc8082d141860aafe0671b8534ac848ca9149.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/861cb2d08543781f4d9909bde6669ce7a7e5f78c.png[/img]
Screenshot submissions made by Time Bandit.
[b]
If your friend in multiplayer uses a car mod, given you have that mod installed, he will show up riding that mod car whilst in session! Past self cars should now also show your items displayed on the car![/b]
[b] If you have an old timey car from 1920, past citizen from around that time period will not bat an eye at the car. So you can perfectly blend in. Except if you start flying around with it... This would apply to as far as 1890 potentially as I added a bit of wiggle room, as to when a car was made and when it gets to be seen as suspicious.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/89004ecadc173b650729284bb662bb7ea4c0b703.gif[/img]
[h3]Crates now spawn goodies![/h3]

[h3]And with that I hope you enjoy this new entry.
The game is coming ever closer towards beta (by the end of 2025), which will have major focus on Quality of Life improvements and bug fixing only! And after that, the game will become fully released.
I will still do regular updates past that point, but I may focus on a second project after.[/h3]

[b]So this is the Roadmap till 2026[/b]

notes.title: V0.97 World Addon Editor Pt.1 | New Car Wheels & Futurism | Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
[h1]Hello dear players![/h1]

[h3]I am back from my week long hiatus at real life Fort Dun, taking a break from electronics![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/5d3556d80359fb4121b0265ad1aed60aa1450199.png[/img]

[h3]I have been quite diligent these past two months![/h3]

[h2]The World Creator[/h2]
[b]
Before having left last week, I finished the first part of the World Editor, which I wanted to release to the main branch![/b]

[b]I let it cook a little longer while I was gone, to let a couple bugs trickle up, found by the reliable testers on my server, which had to be fixed still.[/b]

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3428136874
[b]Here is an example island for you to download![/b]

[b]Import a height map (by editing the source image which has to be 513x513 pixels)[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/90aad49a43b045f3f94751e9704efec35ddad8d9.gif[/img]
[b]And edit it to your liking [/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/578be179eae2349f905188d978fc2fa4836a0dce.gif[/img]
[b]Add housing or custom meshes and tell the game if it should only appear during a specific time period[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/18813cfe05bb578e29451956c7ee682f7d2d05eb.gif[/img]
[b]You can travel to any level, by selecting it on the new world map. A level addon has a longitude/latitude coordinate, so you will be able to place your map anywhere on the world map.[/b]
[b]Double click on the map marker and fly towards the direction![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/fe2bef528f8f08458a40198d093f8154a0bf3484.gif[/img]
[b]If your level has a ship or airport connection, you will be able to connect to it that way.[/b]

[b]This way it was my hope for you to create custom worlds, to widen the scope of exploration in No Time.[/b]

[b]Does it still have bugs? Yes, as it is an early tool so I suggest creating backups of your mod after every edit at least for now. [/b]

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3441923806
[b]You could create pretty interesting racing track islands for multiplayer with it.[/b]

[b]It is as of yet very unfinished, here is what is yet to come.[/b]
-Custom Npc Names (essentially a system which allows you to chose how to populate the island)
-A traffic system
-Item Editor (allows to create custom items: food, trinkets weapons)
-Quest Editor (Create your own time travel stories for your world addons)
-Custom Radio Stations, traders, and more essential systems

[b]They will likely be released in two further world addon updates in the future.[/b]

[h2]More futuristic Pine Lake![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/89b906325c423a9b99e2cd6da77bb4f879d82b2b.gif[/img]
[b]New futuristic cars can be seen on pine island.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/d5b973540a5187cb259c4f9b85f5b8b1283da73f.gif[/img]
[b]And new cosmetic wheels that come along with them.[/b]
[b]Even though I said cosmetic, most of the new wheels are available in the future and essentially allow an increased flight ability.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/ec05c44a6b25c4e55aed61cc527bc870a511299e.gif[/img]
[b]I call this one the metal knight. You can see the new real time reflections pretty well on this one[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/1c5c5855bb571e8f94444498e88fde1b6272174c.gif[/img]
[b]This one is the snow white rider setup.
I increased the albedo range on the car's main texture to allow for brighter looks.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/3affa56fab5746943769ea6a1aebbd5feffee63b.gif[/img]
[b]These sets of wheels will allow you better tracking across the field![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/4eb7fbc1352d57e41ec06a0ecf493fc3acc5c140.gif[/img]
[b]New technology merges with old technology in 2014 Pine Lake.[/b]

[b]I have a couple plans for the next content updates but I wanted to hear your opinion which should be focused on more first.[/b]

[list]
[*] Multiplayer (melee combat, some more time spent on performance improvements, etc)
[*] Custom Car modifications (enhance your time machine with new abilities, some perhaps allowing you to make the time travel sequence look different)
[*] Car Purchases (This one could be another update which takes longer to do, I was planning on the ability to buy cars and essentially switch them with your mach 3 in the garage, this would also basically make it so future car mods would have to be gotten from a car dealer)
[*] World Editor pt.2 (item editor, npc enemy update, store & shop system, traffic)
[/list]

[h2][b]Getting Closer to Beta[/b][/h2]
[previewyoutube=ElwaMYN-l7Y;full][/previewyoutube]
[b]I created a new No Time Trailer, check it out![/b]

[b]
Once No Time leaves alpha, beta will commence likely by new year. And with that an increased focus on improving the stability and performance of the game as well as crunching up which ever bugs remain, as well as quality of life improvements.

That does not mean that no content updates will occur after or even when No Time fully released.
However focus usually always gets narrowed on stability once all main features are finished.[/b]

[b]The first time since 2019, I have increased it by $2.99
given how much has changed and improved in the past six years since first release, whilst still not wanting to go a high price increase until the game really gets fully released.[/b]

[b][h3]As always thank for your support and good luck on your time travel adventures!
God bless.[/h3][/b]

[/h3]

[*] [b]Car Time Travel and Engine modifications[/b] (In game tweaking which will allow you to change how the car operates and time travels, potentially also adding a car fuel meter and  controlling energy consumption as well as different fuel variants)
[*] [b]Item Events for car items[/b], ergo items you put in like the reactor or fuel cell as well as item cargo.
[*] [b]Multiplayer melee combat[/b] synced up. So you can do sword duels.
[*] [b]Epilogue Ending at Manhofer[/b] (Final sendoff, story ends after this for good)
[*] [b]Planting Trees[/b] (creating a garden in your safe house and real world)
[*] [b]Switching to Beta[/b] (After this is done, I will move the game into the beta phase, a special focus on QOL and bug fixes will be taken, it is also during that time, that I will increase the price tag. [b]The price was 10 dollars since the game initially released given how much the game has been improved on in those 6 years of development, I believe 15 dollars for the beta state will an appropriate price tag[/b])

[h3]Thank you for your continued support!

notes.title: V0.958 Combat Revamp with Swords & Armor, New Mining System, much more!
notes.notes:
[h2]Hello fellow players![/h2]

[h1]ACT 4 Progress[/h1]
[b]The fourth is slowly reaching its final stages with the last two quests now being in the works
I had a few stalls due to me having to work on bug fixes and patches but if all goes as intended things should be finished soon enough. As scripts and 3d levels for both of the last quests have been already done for the most parts.[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/f85b5106e6bc4cdd0fb1649d37ecda6cbeece649.png[/img]
[b]
I will soon be going into some closed beta tests where I will let some people test the story whilst I finish the end parts.[/b]

[h2]New weapons.[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/f704cf168fae5a478b22552a410c2ecf16ec282a.gif[/img]
[b]
All types of swords n other weapons can be either retrieved from bandits or smiths from around the island![/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/43e463815dfe30e67be6ace84a7cc687ffc92fd2.gif[/img]
[b]Once you gain a formidable sword, you will also have to be strong enough to wield it! Your strength adds also positive boni to overall damage with swords.[/b]

[h2]Directional Combat[/h2]
[b]
As I was in need of a new combat system for [u]act IV[/u], I made it a bit more tactical
and interesting as well as a bit less button mashy. [/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/743746fb7730b87369912ba5827fdf4140bff80b.gif[/img]
[b]Your mouse movement decides your angle of attack or block. Hold and release to deal your blow![/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/b5873ab49242926e4d1c30b635ef46a6f25432e2.gif[/img]
[b]The direction of blocking is not so much important as the ability to have your sword covering you from the direction as the enemy attacks![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/47e3ee6208ee558d34b971465eccac69e9364ebe.png[/img]
(this actually takes me back to my older project called Dark Sea, where I originally implemented this combat system in a more crude way)

[b]It is also a fact that that Edward Athor originates from that game. In Dark Sea he was a cooky pirate inventor, who needed your help in creating a weather machine sound familiar? You can read some of that story in the Adventures Book Stands in No Time.[/b]

[h2]Weapons holstered.[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/09a89f88e4504ee65db4c4872f6de3aea6a7747a.gif[/img]
[b]
Weapons now show up on the character if in your inventory![/b]

[h2]Armor and new Health UI[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/9430d514782d2c4c50886e203ae7b779c651cfec.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/06e501476f07082b0f8e6d428d67637f385648dd.png[/img]
[b]Every costume now has a visible armor rating. Whilst there was a percentage based damage modifier before, this time around it is more thought out. (I've revamped the UI looks a bit to make it a bit more appealing to the eye)[/b]

[b]The armor rating tells you how much damage it will be able to withstand as a whole, meaning with armor of 50, pruny weapons like clubs or swords will only deal 1-3 points of damage at best becausae they have a damage count below 50 (10 weapon damage - 50 armor is negative so give the player 1-3 points of damage).[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/ee7b9bf49a7d6fc51969eeb0eef0b303c29d996c.gif[/img]
[b]If a saber deals 60 points of damage, and your armor has a rating of 50, it will deal a base set of 1-3 points + 10 extra points and so on. (And yes you can block shots with your sword) [/b]

[h2] New Armor [/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/3419d54a66afb67c17a9e0bfe78e481c8095154d.png[/img]
New types of armor and medieval clothing can be bought from the hunter, to make you merge in better with the old folk!
The pirate costume has been also revamped!

[h2]Mining![/h2]
[b]
Mining ore is now time tracked. Meaning it will not respawn unless you time travel to a date before you mined the ore dry![/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/bcd6613ee6b5ea2d37025e7f136dbf3aecc1e17f.gif[/img]
[b]IYou have to equip a pickaxe and hit the ore to get something out of it, or use Edwards laser.[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/7231a961946e7f13889576b08418cfead6201d30.gif[/img]
[b]I also revamped their looks to make them look a bit more interesting.[/b]

[h2]More retributionists[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/15f2664a46d977baa664a9fcbecc24ef3ec33635.gif[/img]
[b]Dark Mages are seeking retribution for your help in the Hillmen Quest![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/96522a0bc610be507e48805c681ff679c209583d.png[/img]
[h2]There's much more in the changelog to be checked out so please do!
I am working hard on act 4 and along with it will likely come some revamps of the whole epilogue quest as well, to make it more streamlined to get quicker into the main quest of the fourth chapter.[/h2]
[h2]
Hope you find much fun with this update, and the next one will likely focus also on some things related with weapons and hunting as I am planning some revamps on that end as well![/h2]

[h2]God bless and enjoy![/h2]

notes.title: Patch Notes 0.94p6 | IMPORTANT PERFORMANCE FIX
notes.notes:
[h2]Hello fellow players.
[/h2]
[h3]I had players reporting an increase in performance drop for some over time as they played on one save file, which turned out to be due to redundant copies of items caused by your past self taking an item back to its inventory.[/h3]

[h3]It should be fixed now and the redundant items will be removed out of your save file.
If you encountered this issue, save and load your save a couple times so it can cycle through your inventory and remove the fake copies.

This will work by the game checking if the item is in its box position, and later checking if it is not attached to any box in game.[/h3]

[h3]Below are more patches that were made throughout the weeks after the update.[/h3]
[h3]
Have fun in No Time and God bless![/h3]

notes.title: V 0.94 Cinema | Xbox Gamepad Support | Act 4 News

[h2]Hello fellow players!
[/h2]
[b]I've been spending the past month working on ACT 4 whilst doing some content on the side![/b]

No Time finally has some working game pad support, albeit only for xbox one / 360 for now!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/6b8ff0a344f5c7d059c0f13895c313ff08c51dfb.gif[/img]

There are two cinemas now on Pine Island!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/13c033b4a831d3f40ad3867f1ab9c89c3b7f20cc.gif[/img]

One is next to the book store in Pine Lake, the other is a drive in open air cinema next to the meadery in Fisher Bay! This one is only active during night time but is free of charge!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/aafdb427d53aa186f9906471bfa5eac07414ff5e.gif[/img]

Currently the cinema has two public domain short films. If you have suggestions for more films that I can add, [b]comment them below! :)

If you only hear music playing, wait a while the movie will start shortly as the movies are being played on a 2 hour basis with fill ins in between.
[/b]

[h3]Explosive Barrels[/h3]
I've scattered these explosive barrels all over No Time!
They do damage if shot at to nearby enemies, or even yourself!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/c729cec69342ce13d7e8c7ac79b36072a4bac418.gif[/img]

Procedural Space Baces & ACT4[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/ff5feb1f0c9fa7912e32293cba5e47ef295a2e2c.gif[/img]
Space has new places to explore! A new base generation system has been created in preparation for ACT 4!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/d0d9266a7f900cb9cf9dc7a36d1c2f20f620b56a.gif[/img]

You will find new robots scattered across the future of Pine Island and even Mîm's bases in space.

notes.title: V0.92 | Weapon Mods | Workbenches & Meaty Beetles
notes.notes:
[Thumbnail submitted by Nekopheus]
[h2]Hello fellow players.
I am back from my week long hiatus that was in real life Fort Dun and a new update has been released.[/h2]


[previewyoutube=T1BDToTxDPs;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]You can now completely customize your basic EPA and flash saber![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/577056667d0f9470a7619ccb90c175f4ad6f8e07.gif[/img]
[h3]Acquire different noble gas types and components that will make your weapon behave differently in air. Hydrogen for instance tends to rise upwards whilst Neon is stable for long distances, Argon drops down[/h3]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/05d8faf944b9785ea7d84ef90fcdb06fb1488139.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/05d8faf944b9785ea7d84ef90fcdb06fb1488139.png[/img][/url]
A slightly heavy gas that drops to the ground over distance.
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/ab470d3e0914c8aa0901183a29dc3ce862df9ac0.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/ab470d3e0914c8aa0901183a29dc3ce862df9ac0.png[/img][/url]
Creates heavy bolts. That drop quickly to the ground.
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/75ca3d1ac1ed1518ab6a3af4c5bd6a3bd1c5c2bd.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/75ca3d1ac1ed1518ab6a3af4c5bd6a3bd1c5c2bd.png[/img][/url]
Hydrogen rises into the air over distance.
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/472522d83c3d7697554cbb75be37212bb44c0ae0.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/472522d83c3d7697554cbb75be37212bb44c0ae0.png[/img][/url]
Neon is used best for stable distance shots.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/576bf9c7e5e0f4e7fc1fbf72bc5f344974d6a1c6.gif[/img]
[h3]By default your epa will draw air and create a plasma arc. That's why basic flash sabers and epa's won't work on the Moon for instance, there is no atmosphere to create an arc. Mars creates a low powered plasma bolt.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/21897ddeb5228e6a8592d9accfd34b5b99edb7b3.gif[/img]
[h3]You can find different control chips from some enemy drops, capacitors and gas types can be found in stores in modern types.[/h3]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/250fe54a5a198902570a8c50f7fc8059c34202f5.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/250fe54a5a198902570a8c50f7fc8059c34202f5.png[/img][/url]
The repeater allows you to shoot in full automatic mode.
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/3707c8251510fc3696a842b590045b8ed2068672.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/3707c8251510fc3696a842b590045b8ed2068672.png[/img][/url]
This chip discharges all capacitors into one single shot.
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/37ea128076a6b109a951c0cd89cd4b7932c2cfae.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/37ea128076a6b109a951c0cd89cd4b7932c2cfae.png[/img][/url]
The basic single shot chip that comes with every epa.
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/494dfce557c38919bca8485e81184b3a32bce865.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/494dfce557c38919bca8485e81184b3a32bce865.png[/img][/url]
Basic Capacitor (Better keep them at low voltages, higher voltages make them explode)
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/a444e89af783c885831867a05eeb23374d871dd2.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/a444e89af783c885831867a05eeb23374d871dd2.png[/img][/url]
Medium tier cap is able to hold more charge and it's working voltage is higher.
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/f685c9a301d054bc8e34a8282e05eaae69e7e0cc.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/f685c9a301d054bc8e34a8282e05eaae69e7e0cc.png[/img][/url]
High power cap is best for fully automatic shots.
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/612b0a9a82f211081ab0561c3c6629c1b7cb0984.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/612b0a9a82f211081ab0561c3c6629c1b7cb0984.png[/img][/url]
Basic accelerator coil.
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/cb9b7d09674fa87d1ea7290ee3063798c1e125ab.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/cb9b7d09674fa87d1ea7290ee3063798c1e125ab.png[/img][/url]
The blunderbuss splits a single bolt into many weaker ones.
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/faf7b6f492022ccead27942c3129cd3e6ebe9bb5.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/faf7b6f492022ccead27942c3129cd3e6ebe9bb5.png[/img][/url]
The advanced coil speeds up the bolt and makes it faster.
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/fe3399e10eeaf6706a768df152adec82e407e216.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/fe3399e10eeaf6706a768df152adec82e407e216.png[/img][/url]
The phased plasma accelerator uses laser tech to focus the plasma bolt into one point perfect quick bolt.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/ec6fc5b25327b9374af019a6978cf3e4728aa719.gif[/img]

[h3]
In order to modify your base EPA model head downstairs to Edwards basement and interact with the workbench whilst holding your weapon.[/h3]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/0b5d98d93debb4385c7cb01bc4f0d9511468c157.png]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/0b5d98d93debb4385c7cb01bc4f0d9511468c157.png[/img][/url]
Scopes allow you to zoom in on your target.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/5c5b03b2785ca03eb8221a87f50832585624d98c.gif[/img]

[h3]Meaty Beetles inhabit Pine Island! They can be found all over the place and are pretty peaceful and also nutritious. Though I doubt anyone would actually want to eat them...[/h3]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/59e5c2a0431d459e2500bc8a409f89c1501c4af1.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/59e5c2a0431d459e2500bc8a409f89c1501c4af1.png[/img][/url]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/0d2cc05f6296adbf7d300d0946ae126ba53b78c7.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/0d2cc05f6296adbf7d300d0946ae126ba53b78c7.png[/img][/url]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/837a2ba909430b5b5931fa34e6df88c4637708f6.gif[/img]
[h3]...Unless you are living in 300BC! In the old forest city you will find a "delicious" recipe for Meaty Beetle Stew![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/3439eeb1e747b3f0d87c385c9234194964eac01c.gif[/img]
[h3]Now your safehouse will be able to have the dialing panel, making it easier to use your own Space Gate[/h3]
[h3]I focused more heavily on bug fixing this update and this month I will focus more on completing ACT 4. The finished story script is ready to be put into action :)[/h3]

[h2]If you liked the updates I've been handing out this year, give it your voice for the Steam Awards and enjoy the update![/h2]

[Thumbnail by Nekopheus]

[h3]God bless
-Erathor[/h3]

notes.title: 0.875 | THIRD PERSON UPDATE | BOUNTY HUNTING | HUGE CITIZEN REVAMPS!
notes.notes:
[h2]Hello fellow players![/h2]

[h2]Last month there have been a few patches including some additions, which I chose to also cover in this announcement![/h2]
[Credit goes to Szogun and Time bandit for making screenshots for the Thumbnail]

[h3]TRAFFIC LIGHTS AND INTERSTATE ROADS[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/4aa97fd26e54306b21d7e57d2967a45ff762f940.gif[/img]
[h3]Pine Island finally has some traffic rules in place! Cars still sometimes tend to crash, but they drive more carefully now ;)[/h3]

[h3]I thought of making high way around pine island less linear and more interesting, I might expand on that in the next update after this one.[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/237616887406925daa577e464836a4b434fd6e5e.png[/img]
[h3]Here you can see a road leading between pine lake and fisher bay.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/99bc772309fffbaf4de71aeb88504302ad317e38.gif[/img]
[h3]Fisher Bay itself has some road remodeling![/h3]
[h3]As you can see the ocean finally blends in well with the atmospheric fog.[/h3]

[h3]THIRD PERSON MODE[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/07d99f631c4175aea82311f1d6b4fc7ca816fc0f.gif[/img]
[h3]Simply press V when ever you feel like it, to see how beautiful you look from a thirds eye perspective![/h3]

[h3]CITIZEN & PROCEDURAL FAMILY TREES[/h3]

[h3]The game now has a new feature in place which I have planned for long.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/104c891c93daa22df92593e53f6ca8d405e3ed9d.png[/img]
[h3]Every Citizen Npc now has a unique look, no more duplicates! 
I've built a new system from the ground up where faces, skin color, gender, and clothing all mix together to create a unique look.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/be564afe1fc6cdf3169496ab68ff434aa8e3fde4.png[/img]
[h3]Npcs also wear weather appropriate clothing! (Picture made by Davesoft) [/h3]

[h3]Secondly all NPC's from the 16th century (Cape Dun gets founded) to 2030 (and soon also 70)
are part of a procedural family tree system. [/h3]

It works as follows:
[h3]
1#
[b]A family migrates to one of three locations[/b]
-Ard Vuran (A desert country)
-Archos (The trading guild island)
-Lechwia (The temperate climate)[/h3]
[url=https://no-time.fandom.com/wiki/Map:Lechwia]Click here for a map of a portion of Antillia[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/cc47873b296e71dc2259ae6bba6cb39724e70a0f.gif[/img]
[h3]2#[b]They then marry, have children and if other cities are available, move to other cities.[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/695254be4bf414647f54aab5cbbd541149c21112.png[/img]
[h3]3#[b]And eventually they die, this is when you will be able to look at a local graveyard and see their entries there...[/b][/h3]

[h3]Depending on random chance, or economical situation (or if the family is called Crimson)
there is a chance for an npc to turn EVIL. They will become ruffians and bandits and over time they will do crime, rob, kill and even capture innocent citizen, to drag them into their hideouts. Saving citizens may have unforeseen consequences as to how the family trees will look in the future. New NPC's might get born or entire families will look completely different![/h3]
[h3]
(Note that as new updates come, some families might change during your playthrough as the procedural structure could get altered by adding new features or quests in that regard)

BOUNTY HUNTING & BULLETIN BOARDS[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/f4e2505617deb37770cb76a7dc825e9589f97929.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/954dc15da97c41c5c08fedc1cb71bab0f93c23a5.gif[/img]
[h3]To prevent them from doing harm you can take up hints from the bulletin boards, where they might be hiding.[/h3]
[h3]Every city has its own board with local affairs.[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/097ca022a2adc7434e56e018e6938dd6c3c2e67e.gif[/img]
[h3]
Follow the wanted lead, free the prisoners and bind the ruffian, drag him to either Westwood or Cape Duns barracks master, and collect your reward![/h3]
[h3]
This is one of the first radiant tasks which I wanted to implement for long. (Perhaps job requests or animal/ monster hunting will be added in the future)[/h3]

[h3]RENZO & JOACHIM
A digital comic is being made by Rensow, telling the story of the Gold Time Line (The original timeline which initiated the whole adventure of No Time)[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/b3033e65debe05fa0d88cca847b7a4be76d9302a.png[/img]
[h3]He has made his own stories before, so we thought that it be cool if I implemented characters out of his personal stories into No time.[/h3]

[h3]There is a little easter egg in No Time, where you can spot them. Go to Edds basement and find the hint as to their location and time period.
Next update will likely be focused on the post 2030 future up to 2070/80, so this is something to definitely look forward to :)[/h3]

[h2][b]If you like No Time and are stoked about this update, and want to aid in its growth, share the game with your friends or write a comment about it on your Social Media! 

If you have favorite Streamer or Youtuber, write a comment about No Time. For every 10 people who see your comment, one might like it and might even check the game out! ːsteamhappyː[/b][/h2]
[b]

Thanks again to everyone who has been along the ride so far.
- God bless![/b]

It took me a bit of work and looking into some good introductions to custom solutions online.[/h3]

notes.title: Animal Taming | BC Travel (Late Game) | Accurate Solar System!
notes.notes:
[h1]Hello fellow players!

I've been chiseling away at this update for a while now.[/h1]
[h2]
PET ANIMALS[/h2]
[b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/47a23d2b3cda5751821785edf9c3e2fae9125d0b.gif[/img]

One of the earliest requested features is now finally a reality.[/b]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/3f423e867e2ab25be6caa35030621d82122e4733.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/bad3a06f3cc267f3a23d5b54262f25c1dc058f4c.png[/img][/url]
[b]Head to Eddies basement to find all, that's necessary to make a pet capsule!

Now you can turn almost any animal into a pet, you either have to make it like you or you beat it up till two hearts remain![/b]

[previewyoutube=tV7cMX55CCk;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Then throw a pet capsule at it and voila, it's yours! You have to take care of it however and feed it regularly, or it will grow weary of you.

Each animal has something that it really likes. If you find that item, it will be easier for it to get to like you. In turn if it likes you, you can pet it.

The more it likes you the more likely it will be to help you in combat or follow you immediately.
The first case being dependent on the animal type of course.
[/b]

[h2]TRAVEL TO BC YEARS!
[/h2]
[b]If you are in Late Game (Post ACT III) or in Sandbox, you will get the ability to travel to BC Dates!

If you're in story mode and got to the point, where Edward gives you a treatment of exposition in the safe house, head back to him and he will hand you a blueprint for "HVD Chips"

1# Get an hvd, inside it you have to write a "startup.eee" file with the first line being
overridedate -101215001200 
(This will send you to 1500 BC, removing the minus will send you to 1500 AD)
The command parameter works just like the cars date input mmddyyyyhhmm

2# If you want to know what dates are able to be traveled to you can execute the timegraph command in the command shell, simply write timegraph

3# Save and eject the diskette once done, then craft the HVD chip (That you got from Edward in Epilogue) to make your custom chip![/b]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/6826572f1499fbaa5b8077342b88fe9dc90650a8.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/6826572f1499fbaa5b8077342b88fe9dc90650a8.png[/img][/url]
TLDR This is what you got to do.
[previewyoutube=UXbILa64KRw;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]NEW TIME PERIODS!
[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/d89e879870a674935d8b0fd46844f78405d09ae7.png[/img]
[b]1-1500 BC (Native Era)
You will find the great underground city of Uroruh populated.
The two cities (Including the Old Forest one) Have now traders which use ancient coins as currency.[/b]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/8f77af222ce3af367f8a13ee386b4c53b1444bf5.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/8f77af222ce3af367f8a13ee386b4c53b1444bf5.png[/img][/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/5ff6d4a198a61227a1758c77cd38591e25b75678.png[/img]
[b]1501-2385 BC (Little Ice Age)
There was a little ice age on Pine Island after the cataclysm.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/19b36d9b36ef071d4363c06da1125127b418ffd9.png[/img]
[b]2388-4000 BC (Ancient Era)
Back then Pine Island was still lush and green. Something is strange about the air though.[/b]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/b967f5ea0c7464388e486b5d85d9a7fa0d5b4c64.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/b967f5ea0c7464388e486b5d85d9a7fa0d5b4c64.png[/img][/url]

[h2]
HVD's and other things![/h2]
[b]
HVD's are the diskettes of the future! They allow you to store stuff on them. You can copy and paste files and set a label on them, so they get a custom name!

There is a button now which prompts you directly into the command shell!

This new update also allow you to make first graphical operations and inputs![/b]
[previewyoutube=HNg7V1NErgc;full][/previewyoutube]
[b]
The example code is in the video description![/b]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/2d9d8231bc94942f3894d276e30e30bb45a01e86.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/2d9d8231bc94942f3894d276e30e30bb45a01e86.png[/img][/url]


[h2]MORE ACCURATE SOLAR SYSTEM![/h2]

[b]The planet's in the sky should now behave more realistically. Meaning their paths and positions in the sky are being calculated according to their orbit time in real life.

To test this I was comparing it to something that happened this month in terms of planetary alignments![/b]
March 10th you were able to see Venus and Jupiter close to each other in the evening sky.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/6562e8b1300335f3dbc2c971a1fcfc777be37a11.png[/img]
[b]Credit goes to TTG for the picture of the evening sky.
Now this is how it looks in game![/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/6313fca53d5066385dde8a853b8254385d9bca2c.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/4c06fe65632239fe560a899624eebb953b616343.png[/img]
[b]To aid you in scoping out the planets, I've added a little solar system model to Cape Dun's harbor!
It is real time, based on the date you are currently in.
[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/37918a6f450561cab1455aafa2db50acb13a4cca.gif[/img]
[b]Btw... I added the arachnophobia option for those who requested it.

There is even more stuff that was added, so I highly recommend you check out the change log!
I will rest now for a while ^^

Enjoy the update and God bless![/b]

Set during the famous pine island cow plague 1865-66.

Cows were an integral part of pine islands economy, which is why the plague resulted in a war as there was a lack of steak, the mad cows were used as cannon fodder by the attacking bandit forces.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/a576e94c82a4d6b19e768ccff8866ae71124f4aa.gif[/img]
Shooting npcs with guns now gives them special animations!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/58f894f79501801b043a43e94682e7fe15db0b40.jpg[/img]
Enemy and friendly npcs in the past carry flints now instead of revolvers, which would come into play after 1866. (Picture was shot by Boba)

[b]WORLD UPDATES AND LORE![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/d3fbe52ef96e3875eaddd7c43686bb666586523e.gif[/img]
You can now find book stands around Pine Island, giving you lore tidbits and stories of the past!
For instance you can read up on the cow wars in the town archives!

The book stands work also as a little preview to my planned revamps of all books. I have it planned so books could be displayed in a separate menu as it is often hard to read the books in the 3D world.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/8ebb9067fad64e09b28f0825433aeea76b29b8b1.gif[/img]
Be there when Pine Island was first discovered by Lord Dun! To figure out when and where, you can read that up on that in Fredichs house.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/187ef0cd99da761b717e8870e9a77d37decf0015.png[/img]
There are many more smaller lore updates, such as an updated sea map and a new map of the continent!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/65d9d7386874f3809de4ab3972df3c7fe6397750.gif[/img]
Pine Island is now home to beautiful grain fields and windmills.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/6ee3aec3adadbe492044242665a92786d705c8c3.gif[/img]
Wind pumps were placed down in the desert regions of the island.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/ccfad8d020b9a8b294a131f36c2a1663dd11e0bd.gif[/img]
Fort Dun now has some padres watching over it during the 1780s. They are based on characters I met on my retreat in early january, they will play a bigger role in the next update.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/ddc3204d99c54768d6c382312a220a384c0da6d5.gif[/img]
I added these little nutria rats, they will become integral in the Fort Dun Quest in the next update.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/bba9a061c16784ae85c50292f43602ec87cd823c.gif[/img]
The Safe House can now have grandfather clocks!

Thanks to Matt for reading over some of the books to check for grammar as I live germany and I often make the odd grammar mistake ^^

Special Thanks to Choo Choo Man for revamping the piano sounds!

God bless
-Erathor
[/h3]

[b][h2]Hello fellow players![/h2][/b]
[h3][b]This update is so big I will have to split it into two parts.[/b][/h3]

[b][h2]CAPE DUN: MEDIEVAL[/h2][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/4acc15576d37dc83a61d8f48e275fef9e39f7883.jpg[/img]
[b]I always wanted to make cape dun more dense and rooted in history.

There is a secret sewer entrance.[/b]

[previewyoutube=Azo5X7ZFiCg;full][/previewyoutube]
[b]Check out the Floating Log Inn! The bard evidently has had a past.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/44560b105e1e11029d4a133d96a24c28a04f4d48.gif[/img]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/f295895a7b89ff9fc89d95c7542a3ba2b390a92b.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/f295895a7b89ff9fc89d95c7542a3ba2b390a92b.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/e9d8aaba6751d49afdba4f020d30599b5c978cc8.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/e9d8aaba6751d49afdba4f020d30599b5c978cc8.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/f30826a1556888433ec14a28f0d86d4fdfc0d202.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/f30826a1556888433ec14a28f0d86d4fdfc0d202.png[/img][/url]

[b]Check out the local smithy to earn a quick shilling![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/e7d85e7739bd9bdee74bbcc4ff65553002d52f20.jpg[/img]
[b]A herbal store, which includes the new sorts of mushrooms, which can be found in the wild![/b]

[b]I know we are already out of mushroom season, but after having wandered through the wild myself I though why not add some mushrooms, they spawn in the wild during the spring and autumn season![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/53b1b9821374924e15dd9e0ead149dab164d59dd.gif[/img]
[b]Make sure you don't eat the wrong mushroom though, it may end up killing you so be weary.[/b]

[b]New Years Eve 1899 is a sad night as the entire old city center burned down due to an unknown cause...[/b]

[b][h2]META ITEMS[/h2][/b]
[b]A new temporal physics rule has been added!
Say you duplicate an item via time travel, so that you have two identical items of the same thing, keep the two well apart from each outer. Otherwise you might end up seeing this.[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/95b892888b85b9913bab490f4edfeef9147f701c.gif[/img]

[b]It is yet untested if several items may gain special abilities through this merging, so I will leave that up to you to experiment with![/b]

[b][h2]ENEMY ITEM DROPS[/h2][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/1c01ae4a2b3d03cc871fcf268cf95552d93f92cd.gif[/img]
If you happen to be out of uranium, coax time agents into spawning near you, they will drop uranium at random.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/a8ae7f2606560091cd4f86215d05d377f09af0c6.png[/img]
Bandits can drop Archos Trading Guild Gold Coins, which can be exchanged for money.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/508ae8f5606d7f1804918a8b17f89831b946d5db.gif[/img]
[b]Destructible misc items are a thing now! I will add more of that sort with corresponding npc reactions in the future![/b]

[b][h2]THE GOBBO[/h2][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/1938a5f06647dac41a2cc0405507921736ae576d.png[/img]
[b]An old myth from the almost forgotten parts of Pine Lakean Lore.
The Gobbo is an evil creature, ape like, which used to live in the wild and attack unsuspecting wanderers. Will you be brave enough to face that ferocious, deadly beast?[/b]

[b][h2]UPDATE PLAN PART II[/h2][/b]

[b]The second update, hopefully to arrive at Christmas will see a continuation of the epilogue quest!
For that reason did I want to revamp the city as well, as a part of the setting will play out there so stay tuned!

[h3]After over month of working hard, researching and learning, I've finally finished the first version of the [b]Car Mod Editor![/b][/h3]

notes.title: V 0.775 || Wormhole Generator! || Space Exploration and new Time Travel Mode!
notes.notes:
[h1]Hello fellow players!
[/h1]
[h2]This months update is crazy!

It revolves about the new wormhole device, also called the Dimension Gate![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/8987b1f23c4a73dfcbb6b423882712b0e92f5716.jpg[/img]

[h2]This device enables you to traven through time, or through space![/h2]

[h3]After you entered Edwards Attic in the alpha time line, you will be presented with the unlockable safe house object and a few blueprints to be crafted.
[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/e585eb94bb89a9def63499db4bfd8b519c0eda0b.gif[/img]


[h2]PLC Commands[/h2]

[h3]Detrimental to this update are the new PLC commands, which come along with this update.
You can find a full listing on them in Edwards Diary in the attic.

The gate has two modes of travel, which get set by inserting the corresponding core into the top slot of the gate device.[/h3]

[h2][b]Time Travel[/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/079a317020a84aaaeea3ea9a608dcb6541b76e06.jpg[/img]
Credit for the screenshot goes to Mr. Walter Binks.

[h3]The Time Module allows you to travel in time similar to the car. It will spawn you on a random location around Pine Island.[/h3]

[h3]For that you will dial via PLC codes a date.
Go to the files tab and create a new file with the .eee extension.[/h3]


//First you need to stand close to the gate and execute this method
connectgate
//Afterwards you can put a wait of about 5 seconds after which the gate should be connected to the PLC
wait 5
//then call the dialmethod, in this case a time module is dialing to the year 2014
dialgate "101020141200"

[h3]
Once it dialed enter the gate!
In order to return merely call this method, if time traveling.[/h3]

recalltimegate

[h3]This will spawn another wormhole in your general area. Only after you used the gate for time travel.
[/h3]
[b][h2]Space Travel[/h2][/b]

[h3]If you inserted the space core, you the dial takes 5 digits to pin point a specific address to a system.
The gate targets places in the ape head cluster as this is where Mim took off to build his space gates.[/h3]

//example dial
dialgate "abcde"
//return
dialgate "xxxxx"

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/7fe2155f2233d3ac97ad440a9a9499e44ca96389.jpg[/img]

[h2]Each planet is unique, and harbors dangers not yet seen in No Time.
You will need a special suit to survive the environments.[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/9d7a58347429d8dddb8dc2ea547b531f2262f64f.jpg[/img]



[h3]If you are at the Epilogue Stage of the story, there is a blue print on top of the Pine Lake Bank which will help you out further. This special suit will make you fit for the most harsh environments. And it even has its own AI speaker system! Plus it makes you more resilient against damage of any kind![/h3]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/dcee0d3d575cb68c4805b40686a8a39f31392625.png[/img]
Credit goes to Sarantos for the screenshot!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/d0ce7aa75d63e6e29f3fb5e6aa6c6ad5c52aef8f.png[/img]
Credit to 7jw for the screenshot.


[h3]Enjoy the Exploration and expect more for it to come in future updates as the gate will play an integral part in the Epilogue Quest (Inofficially ACT 4)

I will now commit to more research in regards to working out car mods as the next update if possible.
It entirely depends on how hard it will be to implement.

Enjoy this update and God bless![/h3]

notes.title: V0.71 | Workshop Update! || German Translation || PLC Cheats!
notes.notes:
[h1]Hello fellow players![/h1]

[h2]I've worked quite hard this month to get you this unique update![/h2]

[h2]The No Time Workshop[/h2]
As promised for this months update I am happy to announce that the foundation for the first Workshop mods has been laid out!
Given that the Steamworks Workshop documentation is not the most thorough by popular opinion.
But with the help of some community posts from other users and Taelyn from Eleon Game Studios I finally managed to get it working.
You can create custom sound packs and language packs! I am happy that some mods have already been created and I count on you guys to make great content over there.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/710a838f9a8a0145a2155a20a0f6a3d2cd1bf664.png[/img]
This is merely a foundation for other mod types to come in the future!
New mod types like texture packs, custom car models and maybe eventually even world addons.
How to upload the mod you ask? Heres a simple and quick tutorial:
[previewyoutube=hkk4J5RCZe4;full][/previewyoutube]



[h2]No Time is finally also available in the German language![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/9a0fbf8830d4bc1b2b434054631ffa1e6141150a.png[/img]

Other languages are also planned, but will be likely be developed in the workshop independently of the main game till the game has been finalised.

[h2]And Finally PLC Cheats are a thing![/h2]
In the PLC you create another .eee file
then you type into it.

[b]cococrab
cocohelp[/b]

Then save and execute.
This will prompt you with a list of available commands.
[previewyoutube=aplDOhuoWi0;full][/previewyoutube]
Initially there were no cheats since the story was still in development and I wanted to keep the suspense.

But now that the main story at least is out, I'll be able to reopen that part of the game to you!

Enjoy!
This update was more on the technical but still very important for future content.

Expect next update to be about the wild west and possibly the last major narrative side quest
to be added before the Epilogue.
Full change log below.

Stay tuned, God bless.

-Erathor

notes.title: ATOM n TRAINS Update! Cool new Features! V 0.7
notes.notes:
[h1]Hello fellow players![/h1]
[h1]This months update is a biggie.[/h1]

[h1]The game has new trains![/h1]
[b]New features for the trains include arrival announcements, time plans, train passengers getting in and out of the wagons. And lastly a revamped timeline system for train as well which allowed me to create new train stations, spread across the map of Pine Island!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/0b80eae99f7df7819b10e0685d153ff4059fb0db.jpg[/img]

The Steam Locomotive 1870s
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/519b61dd601373c91f52994476714068f5fcf282.gif[/img]
1950s Passenger Train
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/f1506bbab7a76feceb79905617e178be4aa43bb7.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/680c9eef21ba4b2bdf25bc7bc8852dd0015807c6.gif[/img]
And the well known 2014 Hover Train!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/44f00b97a49239e7bf23b38526f79f5ded751003.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/768bec8f53020df2cf602088454d05be3e5e7f54.gif[/img]
The PLC received a big overhaul in looks and function. 
The current date is now displayed on the bottom, making it easier to distinguish the current time with the required quest time!
You can now write custom notes in your journal and even write little code pieces.
This new feature is especially interesting and important for the future.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/ff4dfb043c90a854c55dcc842d7f90ecf2b2b363.gif[/img]
With the implantation of the Mini Script interpreter, this is now possible!
The idea is that in future updates you could make or buy cartridges with specific codes, to hack or bypass systems (If you wanted to go down that route) Or play games on it, written by other players!

This could also open the doors for possible custom code mods for AI or other interesting things of the like in future updates, so stay tuned in that regard!
Here is some reference material if you want to try it out on the PLC! A hello world example code should appear in the first save file you load after the update.[/b]
[b]
Try this little code snip out as a test:[/b]
print "hello there"
breakline
wait 2
draw 1,10,100
print "look I drew something :D"
wait 3
clear
print "ok you can go now..."

https://miniscript.org/wiki/Main_Page
https://miniscript.org/files/MiniScript-QuickRef.pdf
https://miniscript.org/files/MiniScript-Manual.pdf

[b]Radiation Poisoning is now a real threat! So I suggest you get hold of a radiation suit, when handling uranium rods!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/0183ce7df11037a7c49b5b6db40cf9fb2f2874db.png[/img]
Should you get a lethal doze, use the "Rads Gone" pack to heal you up!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/80aae89f92404f2cad97230fc8e4dbb30ced6f87.png[/img]
Now most liquids look like liquids! They wobble when you move them around.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/81f3858d0239e1daaa0a96df557ecfa1ff1b3b20.gif[/img]

I've implemented a random environment generation system. It is my hope that this way I'll be able to fill blank terrain with more interesting details and variation in every year. That means that in the future, nature would also look different. Trees could grow and forests would move.
This would be a huge plus on the evolution of the terrain over time!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/28cefed587dd6033d299fa0e69597f42e7bb6d98.png[/img]
Next update will likely receive its first translations, namely German and Polish! Custom Language packs will probably also be the first Workshop Items, that can easily be made then uploaded by you the players!



Now I hope you like the new additions to No Time! Change log can be viewed in full below as usual.
Enjoy the update and God bless!
-Erathor

[/b]

notes.title: V0.696 | Storm&Radios Update! | Edward's Sewer Adventure around the corner!
notes.notes:
[h1][b]Hello fellow players![/b][/h1]

[b]Version 0.696 has made it into the public, here's what's new![/b]

[h2][b]Radios and Stations.[/b][/h2]
[b]Listen to any of presently three radio stations.[/b]
[list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/5bb50e4fb566653b4aa7910b9468e3ceebdfd363.gif[/img]
[*] Radio Andrey: The station of the mega city to the west. Moody synth music, 12AM, 1PM, 16PM and 19 PM you got a local news cycle with police reports or local news.
[*] Pine Radio: Always playing the newest jams, though it gets into weird taste during the 2000s. 1-2PM is News Time.
[*] Fred Radio: The best classics aged well... like m a n u r e. You got callers talking and asking about mysteries, theories and all that good stuff at 7AM, 12PM and 8PM along with a interview segment running at 5PM.
[/list]
[h2][b]
You can drop in your own music as well![/b][/h2]
Just go to your local installation folder and navigate to "_music". Inside you will find folders according to each radio station and time period. The presently accepted file types are .wav and .ogg files.
Enjoy that feature!

[h2][b]Weather Revamp[/b][/h2]
The weather and corresponding weather effects have received a major revamp!

First and foremost a custom written volumetric cloud renderer :D
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/84f3a8da0807225396c13fef55f4006782ba997a.gif[/img]
During storms the clouds sink, covering the sky lane so fly safely!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/09d9795f40d422bb6194ebfa00203b97e122f83d.gif[/img]
Rain drops are now visible on the floor, and I am planning on giving the cars windshields some appropriate rain effects in the future as well.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/aac6d30690c612efb31314293974738dcba837ce.gif[/img]
Thunder strikes are now local. That means, there could be a chance of you getting struck by lightning.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/2974cbfcbe050a83838e4a0d74f261296fb3f3ef.gif[/img]
But that wouldn't happen likely unless you had some kind of lightning rod ^^

[h1]Edward's Sewer adventure is planned to release by the latter half of this month![ Though it still depends on if I get all the recorded voice samples before the set deadline./h1]
[url=https://gamejolt.com/games/EdwieSewie/624613]Click Here to visit the games page.[/url]
[previewyoutube=mWPSIZztC18;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Graphics Fix for New Players! Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Hello fellow players.
For all new players, there has been an accidental reversing of the default graphics settings to the lowest possible, the psx mode (literally meant to emulate ps1 graphics). This was actually a glitch on the side of unity, I have now written a workaround which manually overwrites the default setting to the second most highest.

For all players who have encountered this and thought these were the default graphics, you can change the graphics settings in the options menu, this should fix it for good. For all new players just about to play, do not worry it is fixed for you from the get go!

With this little patch comes also a minute addition. Npc's now make hand movements when speaking. Edward gets a few custom ones, and I am planning on adding more along the line.

Enjoy the game :)

notes.title: ACT III Release planned for this week!

[h1][b]Greetings fellow players![/b][/h1]

Well finally we are here. ACT III is planned to release on thursday this week.
November 12th to give you a number :)

The update will include a new save system which means, if you want to continue your old save game, you need to switch to the legacy branch. This version of the game will be the current default one before the release of ACT III.

A new save system also means that you need to restart your game. But trust me it will REALLY pay off.
While the default branch did not get any new updates for a while, this update will include big revamps to ACT I and II. A big overhaul to the visuals of the AI cars. and inner workings! More things to do, and explore!
Being able to experience the story leading up to ACT III in a new and revisioned way!

Here is the official and final trailer for No Time's Main Story:
https://youtu.be/Ce8cFBocvKc?list=PLViudMPECwSsA6hZj5NZ_5fZSGmctnX9e

https://discord.gg/73S46Gs

[b]Cheers and God bless.[/b]

notes.title: Update v0.3416 | 1 year anniversary | Work on ACT III has started |
notes.notes:
Hey guys.
I wanted to let you know that the game is now one year old since October 26th :D
Lemme rehash how all came together.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/1434ed72b85ffda07d485ad141d01c97b59ae0f2.png[/img]

One night I had the idea of making a time travel game. The idea was that you would be actually able to travel to any date in time :D

So I spent the night with a donut and some coffee to work out the basic structure of driving a car / time system / a tracker, which would record the cars actions and so on.

From there I started on a basic story. I was thinking of you selling things to an antiquities shop. The original inventor (who was your co worker) was kidnapped in this version of the story and was forced to work on inventions for the time agents.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/1e62c9d8246f18823b2e7036723d5cda409d5f41.jpg[/img]
[i]This is the original plan for the map. I am sure some of it may actually look better than it does right now. Some might have looked worse. What I am saying is if you liked some of the original plans let me know and I can see if I can implement it :)[/i]

This antiquities shop later became E.R. Athors lab. And the inventor himself was now the shop owner, instead of being kidnapped. Originally his shop would have been a shack next to the Burger Lord (As a nod to BTTF with docs shack next to the burger king)

I dropped that idea at some point but you can still see the shack. It is just somewhere different. It is now the blacksmith's shop.

Incidentally the Weathermachine quest (and the character E.R. Athor) is a story I pulled entirely from a semi abandoned RPG I never released. So there is this whole back story. The game is called Dark Sea. It may get a real release at some point, thought it may be an entirely different game by then.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/90edc495e9f0c34a7ee407ff61e006b7511a985a.png[/img]

Of course this is not the end yet but see how far we have come in one year. Let us see how far we can get in another one :D

I recently started work on ACT III.
This last act may take a bit longer, because not only am I going to revamp features or add new ones to the list.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/af62656a48552e51e551ff48a34a90b98d503bd5.png[/img]

I will revamp ACT I with an intro section showing how it all came to be (The escape from the facility and so on).
Act II may also get some changes to make a better pacing though I have no really clear goals on that.

To bridge this time gap I will continue with posting smaller side stories and things for you to do :)

Thank you all for bearing with me on this project and let us see where it all will go.

notes.title: Status Update & Roadmap
notes.notes:
[b]Hello everyone![/b]

Some days passed since the announced update but finally I made it... Sorry for the ultra long delay.
Something in the game was causing the program to freeze and crash. I was using any time I could spare to fix the current issue we where having.
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Meanwhile I wanted to let you know what the plans are for the near future and beyond!

As you may know, we have been working on Act II for the past month or so now.
Progress on the script is going well! Most of everything is already set in stone. However, because of the current crashes I was restricted to what I could work on. The crash bug took full priority.

Some information for ACT II:

The second act will most likely have the same length of Act I.
With the release or shortly after I will include 3 side quests.
One will be a quest about the 'probably known' Accordion Man (who is being talked about in the game)

The other two side quests will take place around the year 2010 and onwards.

And for even more in the future...
I am planning on adding:
- multiple side quests and attractions
- reworking the saving system
- POSSIBLY reworking the time tracking (making it dynamic and not a static tracking of the player)
-I will start work on act III and will add a prologue which will explain the story before you start the game in current versions.
- I will rework and revamp Act I and II adding new quests and upping the quality of gameplay.
(So no worries if you don't like something while playing these acts you may have a chance seeing a complete overhaul)

[b]NOTE[/b]
This also means (since the saving system will be remade) that you will have to restart the game. But due to the additions and revamps you may experience the story in a new light with new plot points etc...
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Hope this shows you that work on this project is going well! At our current rate we might be finishing the game around Winter.

I have high hopes that we can make this project a truly outstanding experience during this development cycle.

PS: 
If it crashes again could you send a link with the logfile in the discussions for example. Just load it up to Dropbox or Google Drive :)

Cheers and have fun :D

Erathor

notes.title: A little roadmap and other news!
notes.notes:
Hello there!
It is me Erathor and I'd like share with you the plan for the development cycle.

After the first release you will be able to play the first act of the story and explore the open world of NO TIME.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34710162/abbc98744a42fb2761f4da20ead2cf2a7bf3376a.png[/img]

The second major update will include a huge content pack, that should help make the world more full of things to do and to explore.
Since this is a time travel game, every time period will need its own attractions and jobs, quests, festivities,...

The third major update will include the rest of the story.
That would be:
- act 2
- act 3 and the prologue

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34710162/148b807ff472f6015e0d8835f99c7120198f998e.png[/img]

Between and after the major updates there will be still room for improvement.
Let us say for example that the majority of players would not like the controls.
These kinds of things would fall into that cathegory of smaller updates.
 
That is except the changes where to be made before the major update.
In such a case they would be included in the major one :)

Now for some of the recent updates.
I added seasonal changes to the environment :D

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34710162/794bc597a79e74e8b0f40c2c3b7e5726b3c00cb6.png[/img]

I am currently working on making the transition between time jumps as performant as possible.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34710162/3a01a9b1beead227c056ddbdcc962bc1d94cc991.png[/img]

I will keep you informed on a release date :)

-Erathor
